notes: mode 'recent': the N most recent Camera Assemblea electronic (non-secret) roll-call votes of the XIX legislature, ordered by dc:date descending. mode 'explicit': voteUris lists exact ocd:votazione URIs to import instead (curated by hand), ignoring n. maxVotes/maxPositionRecords are hard caps enforced in tools/fetch_camera_votes.py regardless of mode — see docs/v2/04-votes-import.md for why maxPositionRecords, not maxVotes, ends up being the binding constraint at the n=25 default.
